notes.title: Update Notes 17/02/2023
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We bring you a small quality of life update :)

[i]-healthbar now goes red when HP is less than 50 points
-changed basic controls configuration to something more user friendly due to popular demand
-improved quality of cursor interaction with buttons in menus
-reconfigured the bot to be more aggressive
-Dexter is now a PVP only map[/i]

Thank you for your support and have a great day !
